Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan to keep momentum.

Demo highlights (a few items you called out):
- Inference latency SLO: target 99th pct < 300ms for 512-token flows.
- Throughput: expect sustained 60 QPS for your nightly batch job (100k records / hour).
- Privacy needs: customer-managed keys, VPC-only deployment for sensitive workloads.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency traces are required for your compliance team.

Proposed 4-week POC (goal: validate performance + integration):
Week 0 (Prep): SOW + security kickoff, test account & barebones model endpoint provisioned.
Week 1 (Integration): Connect your staging data pipeline, run end-to-end inference on sample flows.
Week 2 (Scale tests): Ramp to target throughput, exercise autoscaling and batching.
Week 3 (Evaluation): Run final regressions, cost analysis, and deliverables review.

Success criteria (please confirm / adjust):
- 99th percentile latency <= 300ms on representative 512-token requests.
- End-to-end throughput meets 60 QPS sustained in nightly batch.
- No PII exfiltration; audit logs available for sample window.
- Integration with your KMS for key management completed.

Ownership / resources:
- Redwood: Marissa (AE, primary), Neha (Solutions Engineer), Dylan (Platform Ops).
- FinServCorp: Alex (technical lead), Priya (procurement + compliance).

Attachments: FinServ_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW + acceptance criteria), FinServ_Evaluation_Plan.xlsx (detailed test matrix). Also added HubSpot link to the deal below.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm success criteria and target start date (we suggested Dec 7).
2) Sign SOW (I can send DocuSign link once criteria are agreed).
3) Neha will kick off security questionnaire and share minimal access requirements.

If that looks good I’ll send over the DocuSign link and calendar invites for the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
